name: Chandrayaan-3
intro: Namaste again! I'm Vikram, back for a second try!
Engineers made my legs stronger, gave me more fuel and a bigger landing zone.
We're aiming near the south pole. There's also an alternate site 450 km to the west.
Our rover Pragyan is ready to roll out. Pick our spot!
briefing: Descent is going smoothly this time. Fingers crossed!
fact: Chandrayaan-3 made India the first country to land near the lunar south pole.
